label: soda-fl2va-turbo-15s
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: A premium Japanese summer soda television commercial, photorealistic live action with pristine commercial clarity, transparent natural skin, crisp fabric texture, clean edges, bright white and pale cyan color design, sparkling water highlights, polished youthful pop-idol energy. The same handsome Japanese male performer in his early twenties appears throughout, with fresh expressive features, softly styled dark hair, a slim athletic build, and an elegant white short-sleeve shirt with subtle pale-blue accents. He feels charismatic,爽やか, and slightly larger-than-life, like the center performer of a major summer idol campaign. Avoid an ordinary or unfashionable appearance. Preserve his face, hair, wardrobe and body proportions across every shot. No grain, no mosaic texture, no painterly smearing, no dirty colors, no muddied skin, no distorted hands, no illegible logos or text.

[Shot 1, 00:00.000-00:03.000] In brilliant white summer daylight, an extreme macro shot follows a crystal-clear soda bottle covered in cold condensation. The cap snaps open and a precise burst of white fizz and pale-cyan bubbles erupts toward the lens. The camera races through the bubbles in a fast clean transition. Minimal motion graphics made of translucent cyan circles, white arcs and sparkling lines expand with the carbonation; no readable typography.

[Shot 2, 00:03.000-00:06.500] Cut to the young performer running lightly through a modern summer festival walkway decorated entirely in white and pale blue: sheer fabric streamers, glass wind chimes, cool-toned paper lanterns and reflective water trays. His shirt catches the breeze. The camera tracks beside him at waist height, then swings smoothly into a frontal medium close-up as he looks into camera with a vivid confident smile. Sunlight stays clean and high-key, with detailed skin, hair, cloth and lantern edges.

[Shot 3, 00:06.500-00:10.000] Match cut to a close-up as he lifts the chilled soda and drinks. The camera makes a dynamic half-orbit around him while bright bubbles and ribbon-like cyan motion graphics sweep behind his shoulders without covering his face. Macro inserts show condensation rolling down clear glass and carbonation rising sharply through transparent liquid. He lowers the bottle, exhales with genuine refreshment, and laughs naturally. Every frame remains crisp and photorealistic.

[Shot 4, 00:10.000-00:13.200] The festival shifts into blue-hour evening while retaining the white-and-cyan art direction. He steps onto a shallow reflective platform as elegant white and ice-blue fireworks bloom overhead. The camera cranes rapidly upward and circles him; lanterns, reflections and fireworks remain cleanly separated rather than melting into texture. He turns toward camera, energized by the cool breeze, and says clearly in a bright youthful Japanese voice: <d>[Japanese] ソーダで、夏がはじける。</d>

[Shot 5, 00:13.200-00:15.083] Final premium hero shot. The performer holds the clear soda bottle beside his face against a luminous white-to-pale-cyan background. A controlled ring of bubbles, thin cyan arcs and tiny star-like highlights forms around him and the bottle. He gives a confident refreshing smile directly to camera as a final white firework opens behind the graphic circle. Clean commercial freeze-like finish with no slowdown and no repeated action.

overall_soundscape: Hyper-clean commercial sound design. A crisp cap pop and detailed fizz open the film, followed by sparkling carbonation, summer breeze through fabric, delicate glass wind chimes, light running footsteps, the natural sound of drinking, a refreshed exhale and laugh, distant festival ambience, and tightly controlled firework booms. The performers Japanese line is centered, youthful and intelligible, with consistent voice quality.

non_diegetic_music: Bright modern Japanese summer pop with glossy synth plucks, light live drums, handclaps and a buoyant bass line, building continuously across the fifteen seconds. The opening fizz triggers the first beat, the music lifts during the tracking shot, briefly clears under the spoken line, then lands on a clean sparkling final chord synchronized with the hero shot.
